description: Revoke an access token by its key (UUID from npm_tokens). Requires confirm: true. Revoking the token currently in use by NPM_TOKEN will break the next call. Creating tokens is NOT exposed because the endpoint requires the user password — create via https://www.npmjs.com/settings/~/tokens instead.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. Guards against revoking the token you're authenticating with.

name: npm_token_revoke
